description: First they cloned "Dolly", now we've cloned an MTB­but in a 24" version. Boys and girls ages 8-11 will feel right up to par with mom and dad's MTB. Oversize tubing. Linear-pull brakes. 21 speeds. Alloy rims. It's all here and at an affordable price. Boys: Chrome, Matte Blue. Girls: Candy Teal, Electric Purple. DX 2.3 Available in a 9.5" mini version, Boys: Matte Blue. Girls: Candy Teal
